resources.string: Voice and video messages are transcribed on this device with Whisper: audio never leaves the phone and Telegram Premium is not needed. The model is downloaded once on first use, then transcription works offline. Language is detected automatically.
This phone\'s processor does not support on-device transcription (ARMv8.2 with fp16 and dot product is required). Telegram\'s own transcription is used.
